title: Deploy is gated on migrations applying cleanly to the target environment first
asA: operator whose Worker deploys must never reach production ahead of the schema they were built against
iWant: the deploy pipeline to run `wrangler d1 migrations apply` before `wrangler deploy` for the same environment, and to abort the deploy on any apply failure
soThat: a schema-behind-the-code state is impossible in production and a bad migration fails the CI job instead of the customer request

acceptanceCriteria.description: The deploy pipeline definition for each environment contains a `wrangler d1 migrations apply <database> --env <target>` step ordered strictly before the `wrangler deploy --env <target>` step; the Worker deploy step declares the migrations-apply step as a prerequisite (job dependency, sequential step, or equivalent).
acceptanceCriteria.given: the CI pipeline configuration for the project (GitHub Actions workflow, or the pipeline the project uses)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the deploy job's step list is inspected for each environment
acceptanceCriteria.then: the migrations-apply step appears before the deploy step in that job, and any parallelism configuration is such that the deploy cannot start until the apply has exited zero

acceptanceCriteria.description: A pipeline run where `wrangler d1 migrations apply` exits non-zero fails the deploy job and does not run `wrangler deploy` against that environment.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a branch on which the migrations set contains a statement that fails at apply (an ALTER against a missing table, a syntactically invalid statement) and the CI pipeline is triggered
acceptanceCriteria.then: the migrations-apply step exits non-zero, the deploy step does not execute, the deploy job is reported as failed, and no new Worker version has been published to the target environment

acceptanceCriteria.description: The deploy pipeline emits a `migrationsApplied` structured event on the store event log per successful apply, carrying the environment name, the target database name or identifier, the applied migration filenames or version integers, and the ISO-8601 completion timestamp. No event field carries a domain-row value.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful CI run whose migrations-apply step applied at least one migration
acceptanceCriteria.when: the store event log for that CI run is inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: the log contains exactly one migrationsApplied event whose metadata fields match the run and whose payload contains no value read from a domain table
